# Доказательства универсальности и Definition of Done 1.0

Source: [JSON](../../../phases/P17/phase.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Design

detailed

## Goal

P17 accepts the platform produced by P1–P16. It adds no CoreX capability: it builds package-only
release artifacts, proves public extension and protocol seams from outside the monorepo, boots six
pristine installation profiles, upgrades real prior package releases, recomputes the scorecard and
reduces 27 named assertions to one fail-closed release verdict. Product defects return to their
owning phase; acceptance code is not allowed to conceal them.

RAG:— A111 says 27 conditions while its source audit contains 25 bullets. D95 resolves the mismatch
as 25 preserved assertions plus pristine split installation and a useful non-CRM/CMS/Store consumer.
RAG:✅ Composer, Laravel and GitHub primary documentation supports the tag/dist/discovery facts in
`@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design-rag.json`; the exact CoreX profiles and forward-only publication policy are local.

> **Контракт фазы.** Consumes terminal P1–P16 artifacts and the accepted P15 package-name
> branches. Produces one frozen release cohort, external extension/API/consumer fixtures, pristine
> install and upgrade evidence, final scorecard, an executable 27-row DoD gate, a sealed `1.0.0`
> publication packet and, only under G-RELEASE, exact split tags/releases plus post-publish proof.
> Does not repair product behavior, create packages, add runtime dependencies or publish before the
> exact packet is authorized.

> **Phase Assurance | v1.**
> Impact: public-contract
> Integration Seams: package-export · composer-resolution · laravel-discovery · extension-contracts · rest-and-mcp · bulk-and-webhooks · upgrade-path · split-mirrors · release-tags
> Live or Irreversible: yes
> Audit Intent: direct-close-eligible
> Rationale: Routine items are reversible evidence/gates with full review; only P17.12 performs
> irreversible external writes and is separately manual plus G-RELEASE-bound.

## DoR (Definition of Ready)

- [x] No `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` remains; the 25/27 mismatch is closed by D95.
- [x] Every DOD-01–DOD-27 assertion has a named owner and evidence class in `P17-design.md` §1.
- [x] Release cohort derivation, public/private preservation and pristine install boundary are D96.
- [x] G-RELEASE applies only to P17.12 and binds an exact immutable publication packet (D97).
- [x] Six install profiles include no-modules, multi-tenant, worker-only, no-Meilisearch and removable Search Intl cases.
- [x] Every item points to an exact `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design.json` section and remains within 200K.

## Scope Included

Deterministic package-only `1.0.0` candidate; five external extension packages; REST/MCP/bulk/
webhook clients; independent equipment-registry application; six pristine profiles and declared
PHP/Laravel edge matrix; per-package supported-version upgrade proof; final 20×12 scorecard;
README/example/public-API checks; exact 27-row DoD manifest/gate; full release preflight; digest-bound
forward-only split publication and post-publish install.

## Scope Excluded

New public/runtime functionality; GraphQL; Flex product changes; product fixes discovered by
acceptance; repository creation/visibility changes; secret provisioning; force-push/tag deletion;
unlisted Packagist operations; live webhook egress beyond the local receiver; migration of customer
production databases; per-package release ledgers; rewriting immutable releases.

## Dependencies

All P1–P16 items are terminal and required owner gates are resolved. Inside P17:
`P17.1 → {P17.2, P17.3, P17.4, P17.5, P17.7}`; `{P17.2, P17.5} → P17.6`; P17.8 is
independent after producer phases; `P17.2–P17.8 → P17.9 → P17.10 → P17.11 → P17.12`.
P17.12 additionally waits for an accepted G-RELEASE grant bound to P17.11's packet digest.

| P17.3 | External REST and MCP protocol consumers with parity/schema proof. | full |
| P17.4 | External bulk and webhook consumers with local-only adverse cases. | full |
| P17.5 | Independent equipment-registry Laravel consumer without Flex/CRM/CMS/Store. | full |
| P17.6 | Six pristine install profiles and declared PHP/Laravel compatibility edges. | full |
| P17.7 | Supported-version upgrade proof from immutable per-package baselines. | full |
| P17.8 | Final scorecard plus README/example/public-surface documentation contract. | full |
| P17.9 | Normative 27-row DoD manifest and generated product document. | full |
| P17.10 | Executable DoD gate, freshness rules and planted-negative matrix. | full |
| P17.11 | Stable metadata, complete local release qualification and sealed publication packet. | full |
| P17.12 | G-RELEASE publication and exact-tag post-publication proof. | full |

## Required Reads

`@plan/plan.json`; `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design.json`; `@plan/knowledge/research-P17-design-rag.json`; D95–D97;
`audits/2026-09-19-perplexity-3.md` Definition of Done; `docs/dev-doctrine.md` §1/§5–§6;
P11.8, P13.12, P14.18/P14.20/P14.21 and P16.13 contracts; existing
`scripts/distribution/**`, `delivery/**` and `.github/workflows/distribution-proof.yml` precedents.

## Validation

Every package archive is deterministic and installs without workspace paths. All five extension
fixtures pass P11 contract and behavior checks; all four protocol clients pass published-schema and
behavior checks; the independent consumer and six profiles boot from dist archives. Upgrade proofs
bind immutable baselines. Final scorecard is deterministic; README/examples compile against public
API. DoD returns exactly 27 fresh green rows and fails all declared planted negatives. P17.11 runs
the full root/package/PG/architecture/BC/snapshot/anti-weakening/mutation/release matrix twice where
reproducibility applies. P17.12 reconciles exact remote refs, publishes only the granted packet and
installs exact released tags. Skipped/unknown/stale is never green.

## Phase Handoff

Filled only by terminal P17.12. Design P17 executes no product or release item; its semantic Next is
the independent whole-plan Stage 2 design audit required by D14.
